{{Quote|After studying our technology for a thousand years inside the Waymancy Hollow, the Sisters of the Machinesmith had improved on our designs in nearly every way.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''Waymancy Hollow''' was a region that shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Waymancy system/Legends|Waymancy system]]. For a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] leading up to [[7811 BBY]], the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]] studied and improved upon [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology inside the Waymancy Hollow. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Warship/Legends|warships]] associated with the region established a disastrous first contact with the Republic, followed by the conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]].

==Description==
The Waymancy Hollow was a region that existed in the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[7811 BBY]]. It shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Waymancy system/Legends|Waymancy system]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> as well as the object known as the [[Waymancy bridal seat]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
[[File:Waymancy-EGTW.png|thumb|right|300px|The Waymancy Hollow shared its name with the Waymancy system (depicted on map).]]
For a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]], the group known as the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]], based inside the Waymancy Hollow, studied and improved upon [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology, such as weapons and [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. In 7811 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the Republic established first contact with [[Warship/Legends|warships]] associated with the Waymancy Hollow.<ref name="EGTW" />

The encounter, which proved to be disastrous for Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]], led to the conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]],<ref name="EGTW" /> waged between the Republic and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] in several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the Inner Rim and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Systems">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}} notes several astronomical objects at which battles and other events of the [[Waymancy Storm]] occurred. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places all of the corresponding [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identifies as part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].</ref> At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] mentioned the Waymancy Hollow in a brief recount of the history of the conflict.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Waymancy Hollow was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
